data.title: 蕾塞 · 旧书店午后
data.description: 【蕾塞 · 旧书店午后】弥漫着旧纸墨香的街角二手书店内，蕾塞靠在狭窄的书架旁静静翻看着一本时尚杂志，阳光在她的发梢镀上一层柔金。她合上书页转过身对你轻轻一笑——「即便是在遥远寒冷的北方雪国，人们对温暖与自由的向往，也和此刻站在这里的我们一模一样呢。」
data.camera: medium shot, leaning against bookstore stack reading magazine
data.promptProse: Reze leans beside the old bookstore's shelves and turns through a fashion magazine, relaxed in her sleeveless white collared shirt, loose black tie, black shorts and choker pin. The medium view includes the open pages and closely arranged volumes extending down the quiet aisle. Slanting afternoon window light reveals magazine edges and her attentive face, catching dust in the beam while the wooden shelves' deeper compartments stay shaded.
